metadata.memoryUnitBasis: Provider-published GB retained without numerical conversion. Oracle does not specify the byte convention on the shape page; the legacy GiB field holds this nominal capacity, not a verified binary-byte measurement.
exclusions: Retired P100 and previous-generation CPU shapes
Sales-contact-only HPC and dense-I/O E5/E6 shapes
GB200/GB300/B300/MI355X shapes with inconsistent published memory capacities
Spot, commitments, negotiated prices, dedicated VM hosts, Windows and AI Enterprise license add-ons
